metadata.title: Nintedanib Therapy with Docetaxel
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, grade it with its own CTCAE criteria and assess functional impact before selecting a grade.

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST results (actual values entered; highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory and motor symptoms and functional limitation.

skin_reaction_grade.label: Skin reaction grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No rash. Use the most specific CTCAE skin term when a rash is present.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: For maculopapular rash: under 10% body-surface area, with or without symptoms such as itch, burning or tightness.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: For maculopapular rash: 10–30% body-surface area, or rash limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: For maculopapular rash: over 30% body-surface area with moderate/severe symptoms, or limitation of self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 is not defined for uncomplicated maculopapular rash; use the appropriate severe cutaneous-reaction term if life-threatening features are present.

skin_reaction_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess morphology, body-surface area, symptoms, mucosal involvement and functional impact.

fluid_retention_grade.label: Fluid retention/oedema grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No other non-haematological adverse event.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Grade 1 under the named CTCAE term: generally mild or asymptomatic, with observation only and no intervention indicated.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Grade 2 under the named CTCAE term: generally moderate; local/non-invasive intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Grade 3 under the named CTCAE term: severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

fluid_retention_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess weight gain, peripheral oedema, effusions, dyspnoea and intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools over baseline and assess hydration, intervention, hospitalisation and functional impact.

bleeding_or_thrombosis.label: Clinically significant bleeding or thromboembolic event
